pages.text: Seed a universe with a slowly rolling scalar field V = m⁴φᵖ. The slow-roll parameters at the moment the largest scales leave the horizon fix the spectrum of the universe that results: tilt n_s, amplitude A_s, gravitational waves r. Ours: n_s = 0.965, A_s = 2.1×10⁻⁹.
$(thing)Set$(): Potential power p, e-folds after CMB exit, Total e-folds, Mass scale, Trap field.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Inflaton coupling noise: the power p seen is p + 0.01·d.

$(thing)Limits$(): Inflation too short: the horizon problem is not solved; Interlock: inflaton-trap coils not superconducting (too warm); Field above the critical field: the inflaton-trap coils quench.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): The forge runs at a fixed pace.

$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Field at CMB exit: φ* = √(2pN + p²/4)$(br)Slow-roll ε: ε = ½(V′/V)²$(br)Slow-roll η: η = V″/V$(br)Spectral tilt n_s: n_s = 1 − 6ε + 2η$(br)Tensor ratio r: r = 16ε$(br)Amplitude A_s: A_s = V/(24π²ε)$(br)Critical field: B_c(T) = B_c2(0)·(1 − (T/T_c)²)
